fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for a bug request; no owner interview. The intent reports that rhiza session message writes its file under the run's worktree while verifier and review-check sessions run in detached checkouts under the git common dir's rhiza/checkouts, so the relative pointer names a file that does not exist where the session runs. Code reading: messageFolder in internal/api/session_message.go joins session.Record.Worktree; the record's Dir field already holds the checkout a verifier or check session runs in (internal/session/session.go). messageFolder serves both session.message and the arbiter's Deliver (internal/api/run.go), so one fix covers both. The intent allows either writing the file in the session's own working directory or an absolute pointer; the planner chose the working directory, keeping the relative pointer, because an agent reading a path outside its working directory may be refused or prompted. The checkout's .rhiza/.gitignore ignores local/, so the file stays untracked there. Not severe: a workaround existed and no data was lost. Not breaking: no command, flag or JSON shape changes. Nothing is left open.
fields.title: Plan: fix rhiza session message in checkouts (autonomous)
